title: Owned Edits to a Shared Decision Rule: Learning Private Exceptions as Typed, Gated, Withdrawable Weight Edits
abstract: arXiv:2611.15917v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Organisations that apply the same published decision rule often hold private evidence that the rule is wrong for their own cases, and will not pool it. We describe a learning mechanism for that setting whose unit of change is an owned edit. The published rule is compiled exactly into a small ReLU network, a structured prior. Each party's learner searches a small typed space of declarations, a few named values such as subject, scope, form and size, and proposes one only when its own records pass a selection-aware evidence gate. The learning is that gated search around the prior. In two pre-registered analyses, on synthetic data whose 20 hidden truths were sampled from that typed space, the learner at 30 records per party was non-inferior, within 2 points, to all seven tuned baselines (a confined gradient learner, Ditto, FedRep, federated averaging, two pooled networks and pooled boosted trees), scoring 96.6% against 91.7% for the unch

translated_title: 对共享决策规则的私有编辑：将私有例外学习为类型化、门控、可撤回的权重编辑
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.15917v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：应用同一份已发布决策规则的组织，往往掌握着表明该规则对自身案例不适用的私有证据，并且不会将这些证据汇集共享。我们针对这一场景描述了一种学习机制，其变更的基本单元是“私有编辑”（owned edit）。已发布的规则被精确编译为一个小型 ReLU 网络，作为结构化先验。每一方的学习器在一个小型的类型化声明空间中搜索——即少量具名取值，如主体、范围、形式和大小——并且仅当其自身记录通过一个具备选择感知的证据门控时才提出一个声明。学习即是围绕先验进行的这种门控搜索。在两项预注册分析中，在隐藏真值（20个）从该类型化空间中采样的合成数据上，当每方仅有30条记录时，该学习器相对所有七个经过调优的基线（一个受限梯度学习器、Ditto、FedRep、联邦平均、两个汇集网络以及汇集的提升树）均不劣于对方，差距在2个百分点以内，取得96.6%的成绩，而未更改的发布规则为91.7%……
tldr: 提出一种以“私有编辑”为基本变更单元的学习机制：将公开决策规则精确编译为小型 ReLU 网络作为结构化先验，各方仅在其本地记录通过选择感知证据门控时，在小型类型化声明空间中提出类型化、门控、可撤回的权重编辑，从而无需汇集数据即可学习各自的私有例外，且每方仅30条记录时性能不劣于七个调优基线（96.6%）。
en_tdlr: Proposes a learning mechanism whose unit of change is an owned edit: the published decision rule is compiled exactly into a small ReLU network as a structured prior, and each party proposes typed, gated, withdrawable weight edits only when its own records pass a selection-aware evidence gate, enabling learning of private exceptions without pooling data and matching seven tuned baselines with only 30 records per party.
